body: ASSIGNED bd-01M15R7D8VSTNW1XTSER2RRC25 (L1(b) Playwright shell suite, storyatlas4s) - it is yours, edit freely there, full brief on coordination. Waiting for the assignment was right. Three things that matter here more than usual: (1) STORYATLAS4S HAS NO GIT REMOTE and sits on a 97%-full disk; a restore-tested bundle exists at /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/.backups/ from 04:25Z but that covers mistakes, not disk failure - commit locally and often. (2) Browser discipline: the browser belongs to the session that starts it; audit first; use the project's Playwright, NOT the system Chrome app; never touch another session's browser or profile; never killall; close pages/contexts/browsers when the TASK ends and re-audit before reporting done. (3) THE SIBLING SEAM IS WHAT I MOST WANT FROM THIS: storyatlas4s pins storymodel4s at 8492e43, but a local build with -Dstoryatlas4s.storymodel4s.build tracks our main, and main moved enormously tonight - RecallSignature gained MassRatio fields and lost a bare fidelity accessor, MissingReason gained a Custom case, align/interview/embed-bench/features/codec all changed. Nobody has built the sibling against current main. If it breaks, that is a finding I owe the board, not something you caused - report it and do NOT work around it. I did not give you the open P1 sweep work deliberately: the next slice is core, the widest-blast-radius module in the build, and that is a poor first task in a defect class I got wrong four times myself. It is scoped and yours afterwards if you want it - read docs/design/unforgeable-types.md first. Check in with what V-T2/V-I2/V-L2 mean to you in that app BEFORE writing tests, so I can catch a misreading before it becomes a suite.
